about_the_game:
The world has ended, but the road never stops. In this high-speed vehicular roguelike, you’ll drive, fight, and upgrade your way through an undead-infested wasteland. Armed with front-mounted guns and whatever scrap you can salvage, you must push forward through procedurally generated rural roads, highways, and crumbling cities—each run offering new dangers and opportunities.

Drive, Shoot, Survive

You're behind the wheel of humanity’s last hope: a heavily armed, upgradable death machine. Keep your speed high and your reflexes sharp as you blast through zombie hordes, dodge deadly obstacles, and fend off raiders looking to turn you into scrap metal. Every decision counts—will you take a detour for supplies, or charge headfirst into danger for a bigger reward?

Upgrade Your Ultimate Ride

Your car is your lifeline, and keeping it in top shape is the key to survival. Scavenge parts, unlock new weapons, reinforce your armor, and customize your vehicle to fit your playstyle. Do you build a fast, nimble car with precise firepower, or a rolling fortress that plows through anything in its path?

Procedural Roads, Endless Adventure

No two runs are ever the same. Every highway, backroad, and ruined city is procedurally generated, offering new layouts, enemy encounters, and challenges with each playthrough. Adapt to changing conditions, find rare loot, and uncover hidden paths that may lead to salvation—or certain doom.

Roguelike Action with Permanent Progression

Each run is a desperate fight for survival, but even in death, you grow stronger. Unlock new vehicles, weapons, and upgrades to give yourself an edge in your next attempt. How far will you make it before the road claims you?

Will You Conquer the Endless Road?

The apocalypse is here, and there’s only one way forward: full throttle. Load up, gear up, and hit the road—because the undead never stop, and neither can you.
